articles.title: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch
articles.snippet: Strategy, Coinbase, Circle and Robinhood are among six companies from the venture’s initial selection with no disclosed objection, after 90% of issuers opted out.

articles.title: Thailand moves to block Bitget as crypto exchange's local acquisition faces uncertainty
articles.snippet: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, alleging it ran an unlicensed crypto exchange for Thai users from 2022 to 2025.

articles.title: Hyperliquid treasury firm seeking U.S. regulatory nod as a domestic futures platform
articles.snippet: The company said it's trying to establish a U.S. "futures commission merchant" with full compliance for activity with U.S. clients, though the timing is uncertain.

articles.title: Strive buys 15,124 Bitcoin in October, closes in on top treasury holders
articles.snippet: Bitcoin treasury company Strive reported $509 million in third-quarter net income and purchased 15,124 BTC in October, bringing its total holdings to 43,124 BTC.

articles.title: Binance hackers had 8-week intrusion window before $6.3B exploit: SEAL
articles.snippet: The cybersecurity company flagged similar multi-stage intrusion patterns behind other high-profile crypto heists, including the $388 million Bitget hack.
